title: The "recognised test gets no credit" host line does not name the command it is about
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Opus in mailbox-37bcca97 #85 (2026-09-29 08:26Z). After a turn whose credited-form run `pushd "C:\github\Personal\Engram\.worktrees\landing-record" && cargo test landing` passed (10 tests, foreground, a later turn than the edits), the next prompt said: "A recognised test gets no credit: TermAl cannot confirm it ran in …landing-record … because TermAl cannot tell where its shell is … Run it in one call as `pushd "DIR" && …`". Opus concluded that the pushd run was refused after an earlier `cd /c/…` lost the shell.
Code reading at 515a90c (Termal::Opus2) says otherwise. That reason (EngramUnconfirmedReason::ShellUnknown, engram_one_call.rs about line 356) is chosen only for a recognised test with no directory on its line (check.directory None) in a lost shell. A one-call line carries its directory and is credited to it regardless of the shell's history (engram_check_worktree_from, engram_check_paths.rs:749). My own one-call runs from a lost shell were recorded (w-9ebadc01e428 note 7f9bdb13). So the line most likely referred to another test-bearing call in that turn, e.g. a `cd /c/… && cargo test …` in a separate call. The line does not name the command it refers to, so the agent retried the wrong call.
Fix direction: name the refused command, or its first words and key, in the host line, and say when the same turn has a credited one-call run.
acceptance: The host line for a recognised test that gets no credit names that test's command (or a recognisable prefix of it), so an agent can tell which call it refers to; a test covers a turn with one credited one-call run and one uncredited run, and the line names the uncredited one
